doc.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Hobbies on the road
summary: Bandmates passed time with photography, cooking and exploring towns.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did the fellows in that band have like — I don’t know if this is the right word — but did they have any hobbies that helped them get through all that time they spent on a bus or just on the road?

Oh yes. Herbie Jones was a photographer. He took pictures of guys in the band. And some guys would walk. And some guys would cook. Johnny Hodges did that, he used to cook. And some were just — just enjoyed each new town as they came to it. But they had their little hobbies. But you usually, after a night on the bus you are tired. You have time to eat and then make the next concert and go to the next gig.
